recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系可見巨大後骨髓細胞與巨大帶狀核，紅系前驅細胞核大、染色質細緻篩網狀、核質發育不同步，右下角還有一顆有絲分裂中的細胞，整體細胞增生旺盛，符合巨母細胞性造血。
features: Giant metamyelocytes and giant bands with large, loosely folded horseshoe-shaped nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with large round nuclei and finely stippled open chromatin relative to polychromatic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure at lower right indicating active proliferation
Neutrophils with increased or abnormal nuclear lobation
Cellular aspirate particle with abundant precursors of all maturation stages
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with megaloblastic changes in both erythroid and granulocytic lineages. Erythroid precursors have large nuclei with finely stippled, open chromatin that lags behind cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, and granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms. A mitotic figure is present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows megaloblastoid changes together with hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and dysplastic megakaryocytes, with normal B12/folate and possible clonal cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: AML shows increased myeloblasts or sheets of immature erythroid cells, whereas here maturation is complete and blasts are not increased.
CDA shows binucleate or multinucleate erythroblasts and internuclear bridging with normal granulocytes, rather than giant metamyelocytes.
